units: inches; centered 54x36 board; X right, Z up in the PDF map image
policy: PDF footprint measurements are raster estimates, not official physical dimensions. Reviewed centers and touching wall joins use 1/8-inch subdivisions of the six-inch grid. Cardinal wall centerlines use half-cell lines where the PDF is close, otherwise quarter-inch reference lines. Keep intentional diagonals in 15-degree steps. Heights come from authored TTS XYZ scales; the top-down PDF cannot establish heights.

Head Statue.measurement: Median of color-isolated PDF footprints in the snapped terrain frame, subtracting the one-pixel mask dilation, rounded to 1/8 inch.
